# Coin agent pack 0.1.78+1 (pilot)

> Machine-readable guidance for Coin, the Jio Finance design system's React Native components (jfs-components 0.1.78). Generated from the Coin designer guides and the installed package. Every rule cites the guide sentence it came from; every fact has a source.

Read rules.md first. Use this pack only with jfs-components 0.1.78.

## Pack

- [rules.md](rules.md): how agents use this pack.
- [manifest.json](manifest.json): versions, build time, and entry counts by state.
- [index.json](index.json): every entry's id, category, tags, state, summary and useInstead targets.

## Components

- [Button](components/button.md): Use Button when one clear action moves someone forward, confirms a choice, or completes a task. (flagged; JSON: components/button.json)
- [TextInput](components/textinput.md): Use a Text Input for a single line of text, such as a search, with an icon that hints at what to type. (flagged; JSON: components/textinput.json)
- [Badge](components/badge.md): Use a Badge to make a short status, category, or count easy to scan beside the content it describes. (flagged; JSON: components/badge.json)
- [Accordion](components/accordion.md): Reveal supporting details when people need them, while keeping the page easy to scan. (flagged; JSON: components/accordion.json)
- [Stack](components/stack.md): Use Stack when a public component slot needs one token-driven gap and an intentional vertical or horizontal direction. (flagged; JSON: components/stack.json)
- [BenefitCard](components/benefitcard.md): Use a Benefit Card to list what a plan or offer gives, with an optional upsell and one button to upgrade. (flagged; JSON: components/benefitcard.json)

## Not in this pilot

These jfs-components component exports have no entry in this pack. They exist in the package; this pack gives no guidance for them, so treat them as undocumented and work from their types: AccordionCheckbox, AccountCard, ActionFooter, ActionTile, Additem,
